'''The King's Academy''' is a private college preparatory Christian school for pre-schooling through 12th grade in Seymour, Tennessee.
The academy is both day and boarding school, reaching local, national, and international students of all socio-economic backgrounds. The school’s focus is on educating and preparing students academically, emotionally, physically, socially, and spiritually.
